cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Good morning everyone.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: So today we're going to look at an important creative activity and that's hand knitting.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Ancient knitted garments have been found in many different countries, showing that

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: knitting is a global activity with a long history.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: When someone says the word 'knitting' we might well picture an elderly person – a

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: grandmother perhaps – sitting by the fire knitting garments for themselves or other

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: members of the family.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: It's a homely image, but one that may lead you to feel that knitting is an activity of

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: the past – and, indeed, during the previous decade, it was one of the skills that was

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: predicted to vanish from everyday life.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: For although humans have sewn and knitted their own clothing for a very long time, many

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: of these craft-based skills went into decline when industrial machines took over – mainly

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: because they were no longer passed down from one generation to another.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: However, that's all changing and interest in knitting classes in many countries is

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: actually rising, as more and more people are seeking formal instruction in the skill.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: With that trend, we're also seeing an increase in the sales figures for knitting

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: equipment.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: So why do people want to be taught to knit at a time when a machine can readily do the

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: job for them?

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: The answer is that knitting, as a handicraft, has numerous benefits for those doing it.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Let's consider what some of these might be.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: While many people knitted garments in the past because they couldn't afford to buy

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: clothes, it's still true today that knitting can be helpful if you're experiencing

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: economic hardship.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: If you have several children who all need warm winter clothes, knitting may save you a

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: lot of money.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: And the results of knitting your own clothes can be very rewarding, even though the

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: skills you need to get going are really quite basic and the financial outlay is minimal.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: But the more significant benefits in today's world are to do with well-being.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: In a world where it's estimated that we spend up to nine hours a day online, doing

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: something with our hands that is craft-based makes us feel good.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: It releases us from the stress of a technological, fast-paced life.
